verdict.rationale: The evidence shows llama.cpp's own `llama cli` and `llama serve` commands, a built-in web UI and a server. Nothing shows a single command that launches third-party coding agent CLIs pre-configured to use local models. This is a fair axis for a local inference runtime, so the absence of evidence makes it "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch popular third-party coding agent CLIs pre-configured to use my local models with a single command
